svg.aria-label: Li symmetric cycling setup: current I equals current density j times the Li foil area; example: 0.1 mA/cm² with a 12 mm Li foil gives 0.113 mA. Alternate positive and negative. Commonly 0.5 to 1 hour per half cycle, with a voltage limit of, for example, ±1 V. Program: J cyclic charge-discharge, or chained chronopotentiometry steps.
